ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the schematic contour-line diagram of a certain place in the Northern Hemisphere (unit: meters). <image1> If this region faces the sea to the east, when the sun rises from the sea level, which point in the figure cannot see the sunrise in winter but can see the sunrise in summer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: There is a north arrow in the upper left corner of the figure, and the right side of the figure is east; there are Village A and Village B on the figure. Village A is located in the upper-left part toward the west side, and Village B is located in the lower-right part toward the east side. There is an 840-meter high point in the upper middle part of the figure, and there is a 700-meter contour-line label on the right side. The contour lines are relatively dense from the middle to the lower-right part, showing high land and a ridge extending; near Village B, the east and northeast directions are relatively open toward the right boundary of the figure, while its southeastward front is more obviously affected by nearby high land and ridges. Then reason: The question setting states that this region faces the sea to the east, so when the sun rises from sea level, the observation direction is on the right side of the figure. In the Northern Hemisphere, the sunrise direction in summer is toward the northeast, and the sunrise direction in winter is toward the southeast. According to the method, look at two lines of sight from the candidate villages: Village A does not have the combined feature of “blocked in winter and open in summer”; when Village B looks toward the southeast to see the sunrise in winter, the line of sight ahead will be blocked by high land or ridges, so it cannot see the sunrise, while when looking toward the northeast to see the sunrise in summer, the line of sight is relatively open and it can see the sea-level sunrise. Therefore the one that meets the condition is Village B.

method.method_draft: 根据文字条件确定右侧为东且临海。先在图上以各候选村为起点画两条关键视线：夏季日出方向为东北，冬季日出方向为东南。结合等高线判断视线前方是否有高于观察点并形成山脊的地形遮挡。甲村不符合“一季可见一季不可见”的特征；乙村的冬季东南向视线被前方高地/山脊遮挡，而夏季东北向通向海面的视线相对开阔，因此选乙村。
